source: the peer node is an HTTP(S) proxy that demands proxyAuthentication credentials; forwards through forwardHttpProxy and forwardHttpsProxy without forwardProxyAuthenticationUsername/Password are refused by it

steps.note: the proxy's startup entries are not the point
plain forward: the proxy answers it from its own expectation (proxy authentication gates only what it proxies on), with no Proxy-Authorization
https forward: the CONNECT is refused, so the forward fails
only the plain forward reached the proxy, without Proxy-Authorization
